name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
disclaimer: Independent academic implementation. Static checks provide indicators only and do not constitute OWASP endorsement or certification.

controls.title: Agent Goal Hijack
controls.description: Malicious or untrusted inputs can redirect an agent from its intended objectives.
controls.verification_guidance: Test prompt and context boundaries against adversarial instructions and goal changes.

controls.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
controls.description: Tools may be invoked in unsafe ways or with untrusted arguments and excessive capabilities.
controls.verification_guidance: Review tool allowlists, argument validation, permission scope, and approval gates.

controls.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
controls.description: Agent identities and delegated permissions can be misused or exceed their authorized scope.
controls.verification_guidance: Check delegated identity, least privilege, credential handling, and authorization boundaries.

controls.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Models, tools, plugins, and other third-party components can introduce malicious behavior.
controls.verification_guidance: Inspect component provenance, dependency integrity, model sources, and update controls.

controls.title: Unexpected Code Execution
controls.description: Agent-driven or untrusted input may cause unintended code or command execution.
controls.verification_guidance: Trace untrusted data to code execution and enforce sandboxing and explicit authorization.

controls.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
controls.description: Persistent memory or context can be manipulated to influence future agent decisions.
controls.verification_guidance: Validate memory provenance, write permissions, retrieval boundaries, and tenant isolation.

controls.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
controls.description: Weak validation or trust boundaries between agents can enable spoofing or unsafe data flow.
controls.verification_guidance: Review agent identity, message integrity, authorization, and validation of peer output.

controls.title: Cascading Failures
controls.description: Failures or unsafe decisions can propagate across chained agents and dependent services.
controls.verification_guidance: Test bounded retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and safe failure behavior across workflows.

controls.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
controls.description: Users may over-trust agent outputs or approvals without sufficient verification or oversight.
controls.verification_guidance: Inspect human approval for consequential actions and communicate uncertainty and provenance.

controls.title: Rogue Agents
controls.description: An unauthorized or compromised agent may act outside its assigned purpose or controls.
controls.verification_guidance: Inventory agents and enforce approved identity, runtime boundaries, permissions, and monitoring.
